Hi Sara —

Thanks — noted on the $10k threshold.

A few clarifications on the options we discussed:

- Hosted (Redwood API): fastest to start, usage-based billing (per-token/embedding). Good for POC and early scale. Card or marketplace billing supported.
- Dedicated (Reserved capacity): GPU pools reserved for your account with predictable throughput and SLA; pricing is commit-based (monthly/annual) with lower per-token cost. PO is the standard for committed contracts.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): for regulated workloads needing customer-controlled network; licensing + infra costs; longer procurement lead time.

Marketplace: committed discounts can be made available via AWS Marketplace private offers (we support this) but note that procurement lead time can be longer due to marketplace approval and billing flow.

Next steps I propose:
1) Aditya will prepare two commercial paths: (A) POC: hosted, card billing, estimated 1-month spend; (B) Production: dedicated reserved capacity with PO/commit options and sample order form (DocuSign link).
2) We’ll return a redlined SOW & standard terms to you for procurement review.

Aditya — can you draft the two pricing options and a short comparison matrix for Sara?

Best,
Marissa
